title: Fergus J NDE 6524
content: I had arrived at the hospital, suspecting that I was having a heart attack. While waiting to be examined, there was complete cardiac arrest. A doctor and emergency room nurses were summoned and they worked for several minutes to try to restart the heart. I was told later by the doctor that it was an extremely tenuous situation, with no results for several minutes. I do not remember any pain or other sensations as I lost consciousness. The experience itself was very vivid and beautiful. I was standing in a strange place, I could move about, but did not feel that I was walking. It was more like floating weightlessly, but upright in a standing position. It was dark. There was a rail fence directly in front of me, like 10 ft. away. There were three thick rails, the bottom two were dark, and the top rail glowed brilliant white. I moved up to the fence, but did not touch it. Beyond the fence to the right stood a group of people, at least 20 or so. They were all facing me and were silently watching. They were dressed in strange garb, more like close fitting robes that covered their bodies and heads, but not the faces. The material was not exactly like anything I had ever seen. The faces were not covered, and it was too dark to recognize features, but I was certain I knew all of them. My parents stood out, mostly by their outline and position. They were at the front and more to the middle of the group standing together. Straight ahead and next to the group was a very ancient looking stone archway. A pathway went through it and straight ahead through a very long and dark valley. A long distance ahead, the valley sloped upwards. Over the horizon and beyond there was a very bright light shining up into the night sky, like the lights of a distant city. The night sky above the glow was lit with beautiful shades of purple. I stood for a while, just staring at everything, then had a sensation of being pulled back. I woke up suddenly and doctors and nurses around me were calling my name and applauding. I am not one to cry easily, but there I did quite a lot, not from fear or hurting, just the realization of how close I had come to leaving my family and gratitude to the doctor and nurses who brought me back.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: A pathway through a stone archway leading through a very long and dark valley toward a bright light over the horizon.

arrival.other_being_detail: A group of at least ~20 people beyond a rail fence, silently watching; dressed in close-fitting robe-like garb covering bodies and heads but not faces; experiencer was certain he knew all of them; parents stood out in the group.

environment.environment_other_detail: Rail fence with three thick rails (top rail glowed brilliant white); ancient stone archway; long dark valley; distant bright light like a city's lights; night sky shades of purple.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Silent group of people beyond a fence; ancient stone archway and pathway through a dark valley toward a distant bright light; sensation of being pulled back; awakening to medical staff calling his name and applauding.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No reported OBE; experience begins already in a dark realm with a fence/boundary and a pathway toward distant light, then an abrupt pull back and return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Rail fence with three thick rails where the top rail glowed brilliant white; group of ~20 silently watching in robe-like garb; ancient stone archway and long dark valley; distant light like a city's lights; purple shades in the night sky.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “The experience itself was very vivid and beautiful.”
